cues.voiceover: Every off-grid home runs on six systems. R&B's Homesteading keeps all six in your pocket.
Shelter: earth-packed walls that swing less than the air outside.
Heat: a wall of glass that faces the winter sun.
Power: sun and wind, stored in a battery bank.
Water: rain off the roof, caught in a cistern and used four times.
Food: growing beds built into the house.
Six systems. One app. Install R&B's Homesteading.

cards.title: Shelter
cards.text: Natural and repurposed materials; earth-sheltered walls swing less than air.

cards.title: Heat
cards.text: Glass wall faces the equator for winter sun; roof and north, east, west walls are heavily insulated.

cards.title: Power
cards.text: Solar and wind power the house.

cards.title: Water
cards.text: Roof water is harvested into a cistern and reused in stages.

cards.title: Food
cards.text: Food production is built into the design.

extra.note: Clips start with 1.2 s of silence so the logo lands before the voice. Cue times come from the pauses in both clips.
